description: This source file defines the class ContentSearchSession, which manages search options, constraints, and parameters for content search within the OFBiz framework. It includes nested classes for search options, methods for processing search parameter requests, and utility functions for managing search state and constraints.

classes.name: ContentSearchSession
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to manage content search session options, constraints, and parameters within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ContentSearchOptions
classes.description: A nested static class representing the search options such as constraints, sort order, and view settings; implements Serializable for session storage.

methods.name: getContentSearchOptions
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the ContentSearchOptions object stored in the session.

methods.name: processSearchParameters
methods.description: Processes incoming search parameters from a request, updates session search options accordingly, including constraints, sort order, and view settings.

methods.name: searchAddConstraint
methods.description: Adds a new search constraint to the current search options in the session.

methods.name: searchSetSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for search results in the session search options.

methods.name: getSearchOptionsHistoryList
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the list of previous search options stored in the session.

methods.name: searchGetConstraintStrings
methods.description: Returns a list of string representations of the current search constraints.

methods.name: searchGetSortOrderString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the current sort order.

methods.name: checkSaveSearchOptionsHistory
methods.description: Adds the current search options to the history list if they have changed since last saved.

methods.name: searchRemoveConstraint
methods.description: Removes a constraint at a specified index from the current search options.

methods.name: searchClear
methods.description: Clears the current search options in the session.
